verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official Snyk MCP Server as part of Snyk Studio. It runs locally via the Snyk CLI, and agents can be validated by prompting them in natural language, e.g. "scan my directory for security issues". Studio names supported agentic environments including Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the MCP server working in practice, and documentation detail on the specific tools it exposes and how authentication is configured.
